comparison.objective: Attach a detachable saucepan handle and use the locked connection to move a pan; candidate separates a mixed batch with a manual screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Jaw/rim alignment, latching and load-path verification versus bimanual screen grasping, orientation-sensitive sifting and many-body retention.
comparison.success_condition: Prove retained handle attachment under load, place the pan on a trivet and release versus quantitative media recovery plus washer retention, reseating, clearance and dwell. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: This record tests mechanical attachment followed by load-bearing use, not selective granular separation.
